title: C/C++ Development Toolchain — Overview and definition
t: C/C++ Development Toolchain — Overview and definition
description: Compiles, links, debugs, and profiles C and C++ from source to optimized binaries.
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Compiles, links, debugs, and profiles C and C++ from source to optimized binaries. A C/C++ development toolchain provides a standards-compliant compiler, linker, assembler, debugger, and profilers for hosted and cross targets. Real implementations include GCC, Clang/LLVM, and MSVC, with GDB/LLDB debuggers and sanitizers (AddressSanitizer, UBSan). It supports cross-compilation to microcontrollers and optimization levels from -O0 debug to -O3/LTO release.
capabilities: Compile C17/C23 and C++17/20/23 with diagnostics and warnings-as-errors
Cross-compile to ARM, RISC-V, AVR, and other embedded targets
Debug with breakpoints, watchpoints, and reverse execution (GDB/LLDB)
Detect memory and undefined-behavior bugs with sanitizers
Profile with gprof/perf and optimize with LTO and PGO

title: C/C++ Development Toolchain — Actual implementation
description: Compiles, links, debugs, and profiles C and C++ from source to optimized binaries.
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. How C/C++ Development Toolchain is actually implemented. A C/C++ development toolchain provides a standards-compliant compiler, linker, assembler, debugger, and profilers for hosted and cross targets. Real implementations combine CLI (cc/c++/ld), CMake/Meson build integration, IDE toolchains, compiler-rt APIs with Binutils, a C library (glibc/musl/newlib), target headers. The implementation is verified by Verify by building a reference project with -Wall -Wextra -Werror and running its test suite under ASan/UBSan with zero reports; check a known binary reproduces its checksum

title: C/C++ Development Toolchain — Teaching-ladder exercise
description: Compiles, links, debugs, and profiles C and C++ from source to optimized binaries.
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Teaching ladder for C/C++ Development Toolchain, simple to complex. Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (Compile C17/C23 and C++17/20/23 with diagnostics and warnings-as-errors). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output. Rank 5: combine two capabilities: Compile C17/C23 and C++17/20/23 with diagnostics and warnings-as-errors and Cross-compile to ARM, RISC-V, AVR, and other embedded targets. Rank 7: chain its output into a neighboring tool (Python Runtime) with a verification checkpoint. Rank 9+: automate the full workflow and teach it to someone else.
